senses.gloss: उत्क mfn. (fr. 1. उद्, Pāṇ. v, 2, 80), excited by the desire of obtaining anything
wishing for (with inf.), desirous of, longing for
regretting, sad, sorrowful
absent, thinking of something else, Kathās.; Megh.; Śiś. &c.
उत्क m. n. desire, Kathās.
opportunity, occasion, L.
उत्क—ता f. a state of longing or regret, Kathās.
the plant Pothos Officinalis having aromatic seeds, L.
उत्कय Nom. P. उत्कयति, to cause to long for, cause longing or regret, Śiś. i, 59.
उत्काय Nom. Ā. उत्कायते, to long for Comm. on Bhaṭṭ. v, 74.
उत्काय See उत्क.
उत्-कच mfn. hairless, MBh.
full blown, BhP. iii, 23, 38.
उत्कचय Nom. P. उत्कचयति, to coil the hair upwards, Sāh.
उत्-कच्छा f. a metre of six verses (each verse containing eleven syllabic instants).
उत्-कञ्चुक mfn. having no coat of mail, without bodice or jacket, Bhartṛ.
उत्-कट mfn. (fr. 1. उद् with affix कट, Pāṇ. v, 2, 29), exceeding the usual measure, immense, gigantic, R.; Prab.; Pañcat. &c.
richly endowed with, abounding in MBh.; R.; Pañcat. &c.
drunk, mad, furious, MBh.; R.
excessive, much
superior, high, proud, haughty
uneven
difficult
उत्-कट m. fluid dropping from the temples of an elephant in rut, L.
the plant Saccharum Sara, or a similar kind of grass, Suśr.
intoxication, pride, L.
उत्-कट n. the fragrant bark of Laurus Cassia.
उत्-कटा f. the plant Laurus Cassia, L.
N. of a town
उत्कटिका f. a manner of sitting (the legs being outstretched and forming a right angle), Yogaś.
उत्कटिकासन n. id., ib. (cf. उत्कुटक.)
उत्कटुक v.l. for उत्कुटक, q.v., Suśr.
उत्कणिका f. desire, longing (v.l. for उत्कलिका, q.v.), MārkP.
उत्कण्टकित mfn. one whose (thorn-like) short hairs are erected (through joy or emotion), Kād.
उत्कण्टकिन् mfn. id., ib.
1. उत्-कण्ठ mfn. having the neck uplifted (on the point of doing anything), Ragh.
having the throat open (as in crying), BhP.
longing for
उत्-कण्ठ m. longing for
a kind of sexual union, L.
उत्-कण्ठा f. longing for (a beloved person or thing)
regretting or missing anything or a person, MBh.; Bhartṛ.; Pañcat.; Amar. &c.
उत्-कण्ठ—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
उत्-कण्ठा-निर्भरम् ind. longingly, yearningly, Ratnāv.
उत्कण्ठक mfn. exciting desire, VarBṛS.
उत्कण्ठित mfn. lifting up the neck
longing for, regretting, sorrowing for, R.; Daś.; Vikr. &c.
in love, Mālav.
उत्कण्ठिता f. a woman longing after her absent husband or lover.
उत्-कन्द् (for उत्-√ स्कन्द्, Kāty. on Pāṇ. viii, 4, 61), to leap, jump over.
उत्कन्दक m. a kind of disease.
उत्-कन्धर mfn. having the neck erect or uplifted, Śiś.; Pañcat.; Rājat. &c.
उत्-कम्प mfn. trembling, shuddering, MBh.; Kathās.; Prab. &c.
उत्-कम्प m. tremor, agitation, Suśr.; Bhartṛ.; Megh.; Kathās. &c.
उत्-कम्पन n. the act of trembling, shuddering, agitation.
उत्कम्पिन् mfn. shuddering, trembling
agitated, Bhartṛ.; Kād.; Ratnāv. &c.
(ifc.) causing to tremble, agitating, R.
उत्-कर &c. See उत्-√ कॄ.
उत्-कर m. anything dug out or scattered upwards, rubbish, AitBr.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; ĀśvŚr.; Mṛcch. &c.
a heap, multitude, MBh.; R.; Kathās. &c.
sprawling, Bhpr. i, 138.
उत्-कार &c. See उत्-कॄ.
उत्-कार m. piling up (corn), Pāṇ.; Bhaṭṭ.
उत्कर्कर m. a kind of musical instrument, L.
उत्-कर्ण mfn. having the ears erect, Ragh.; Śiś.
उत्-कर्ण—ताल mfn. flapping with erected ears (as an elephant), Kathās. xii, 19.
उत्-कर्तन &c. See 1. उत्-कृत्.
उत्-कर्तन n. cutting up, cutting to pieces, cutting off, Suśr.
उत्-कर्ष &c. See उत्-कृष्.
उत्-कर्ष mfn. superior, eminent
much, excessive, L. exaggerated, boastful, Yājñ.
attractive
उत्-कर्ष m. pulling upwards, drawing, pulling
elevation, increase, rising to something better, prosperity
excellence, eminence, Mn.; R.; Pañcat.; Hit.; Kathās. &c.
excess, abundance
self-conceit
boasting, Yājñ.
excepting, omitting Comm. on KātyŚr.
putting off, delaying, Nyāyam.

उत्-कलिका f. longing for, regretting, missing any person or thing, Amar.; Kathās.; Mālatīm.; Ratnāv. &c.
wanton sportfulness, dalliance, L.
a bud, unblown flower, Ratnāv.
a wave, Mālatīm.; MārkP.; Śiś.
उत्-कलिका—प्राय mfn. abounding in compound words (a kind of prose), Sāh.; Vām. &c.
उत्-कलिका-वल्लरी f. N. of a poem.
उत्-कलित mfn. unbound, loosened, BhP.
opened, blossoming
brilliant, bright, BhP.
appearing, coming forth, becoming visible, BhP.
regretting, longing for, L.
prosperous, rising, increasing, L.

उत्-कल m. (perhaps fr. उद्-√ कल्?) N. of the country Orissa (see Oḍra; the word is interpreted to mean ‘the glorious country’ [Hunter]; or ‘lying beyond, the outlying strip of land’ [Beames]; according to others it merely means ‘the country of bird-catchers’)
N. of a son of Dhruva, BhP.
of Su-dyumna, Hariv.; VP. &c.
a porter, one who carries a burden or load, L.
a fowler, bird-catcher, L.
the inhabitants of the above country.
उत्-कल—खण्ड n. N. of a section of the Skanda-purāṇa.
उत्-कल—देश m. the country of Orissa.
उत्-कलाप mfn. having the tail erect and expanded (as a peacock), Ragh.; Mṛcch.
उत्-कलापन n. marrying, Vet.

उत्-√ कष् (उद्-√ कष्) P. -कषति, to dye, paint (e.g. the teeth), VarBṛS.;
to tear up, L.
उत्-√ कस् (उद्-√ कस्) P. (Impv. 3. pl. उ॑त्-कसन्तु, AV. xi, 9, 21) to gape asunder, open.
उत्-√ काश् (उद्-√ काश्) Ā. (pf. -चकाशे, BhP. i, 11, 2) to shine forth, flash.

उत्-√ कास् (उद्-√ कास्) Ā. -कासते, to cough up, hawk;
to expectorate, Car.
उत्-कषण n. tearing or ploughing up, drawing through (as a plough), Megh. 16.
उत्काका f. a cow calving every year.
उत्-काकुद् (fr. काकुद with उद्, Pāṇ. v, 4, 148), having an elevated or high palate.
उत्-कान्ति f. excessive splendour, Sāh.
उत्-काश n. going out, coming forth, ŚāṅkhBr.
उत्कास m. (g. यस्कादि, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 63) N. of a man
(Pāṇ. ii, 4, 63) the descendants of the above.
उत्-काशन n. giving orders, commanding, L.
उत्-कासन n. coughing up
clearing the throat of mucus, expectorating, Suśr.
उत्-किर उत्-कीर्ण. See under उत्-कॄ, col. 3.
उत्-किर mfn. (ifc.) piling up, heaping up, Ragh. i, 38; Kum. &c.
उत्-कीर्तन &c. See उत्-कॄत्.
उत्-कीर्तन n. crying out, proclaiming
reporting, promulgating, Sāh.
praising, celebrating.
(in dram.) awakening of the remembrance of former events, Sāh.
उत्-कील् (उद्-√ कील्).
उत्-कीलय Nom. P. ˚यति, to uproot, Divyāv.
उत्-कीलित mfn. unfastened, opened (by drawing out the peg), Kād. ii.
उत्कील m. N. of a Ṛṣi, Comm. on VS. & RV. (v.l. अत्कील, q.v.)
उत्कीलक m. N. of a mountain.
उत्-कुञ्चिका or उत्-कुञ्चिता, f. the plant Nigella Indica, L.
उत्-कुञ्चिका or उत्-कुञ्चिता, f. the plant Nigella Indica, L.
उत्-कोच m. winding off
unbinding Comm. on TBr.
bribery, corruption, Yājñ. i, 339.
उत्-कोच &c. See उत्-कुच्.
उत्कोचक mfn. receiving a bribe, Mn. ix, 258
उत्कोचक n. N. of a Tīrtha, MBh.
उत्कोचिन् mfn. corruptible, to be bribed, MBh.
उत्-कुट् (उद्-√ कुट्), Caus. -कोटयति, to bend upwards, Kāś. on Pāṇ. i, 2, 1.
उत्-कुट mfn. lying stretched out on the back, lying with the face upwards, sleeping with the head erect, L.
उत्-कूट m. an umbrella or parasol, L.
उत्-कुटक mfn. sitting upon the hams, squatting, Suśr.
उत्कुटकासन n. the sitting upon the hams, Suśr.
उत्कुटुक v.l. for above.
उत्-कुण m. a bug
a louse, L. (cf. मत्कुण.)
उत्-कुतुक mfn. (ifc.) amusing one's self by, Prasannar.
उत्-कुमुद mfn. having lotus flowers on the surface, Kāvyād.

उत्-कूल mfn. passing beyond the bank (as water), overflowing, Kād.
being on an elevation, going uphill
उत्-√ कू P. -कौति, to cry out, Sarasv.
उत्-√ कूज् (उद्-√ कूज्) P. -कूजति, to utter a wailing monotonous note or coo (as a bird), Kathās.; Ṛtus.; Kād.
उत्-कूज m. a cooing note (as of the kokila), R.
उत्-कूजित n. id., Ṛtus.
उत्-√ कूर्द् (उद्-√ कूर्द्) P. Ā. -कूर्दति, -ते, to jump up, spring upwards, Pañcat.
उत्-कूर्दन n. jumping up, springing upwards, Pañcat.
उत्-कूल॑म् (अ॑म्), ind. uphill, AV. xix, 25, 1.
उत्-कूलय Nom. P. ˚यति, to cause to overflow a bank, Pārv.
उत्-कूल—गामिन् mfn. passing beyond the bank, Kād.
उत्-कूल—निकूल॑ mfn. going up and down, VS.; Lalit.
उत्कूलित mfn. brought to the bank or shore, thrown up on a bank, stranded, Sāh.

to promote, help.
उत्-कर्तृ-त्व n. the being a helper, the state of being conducive to, NṛsUp.
उत्-कृति f. a metre of four times twenty-six syllables
the number twenty-six.
2. उत्-√ कृत् (उद्-√ कृत्) P. -कृणत्ति, to continue spinning, RV. x, 130, 2.
उत्-√ कॄत् (उद्-√ कॄत्) P. -कीर्तयति, to proclaim, celebrate, praise, promulgate.
उत्-क॑र्तम् ind.p. cutting off, ŚBr. xiii, 7, 1, 9.
उत्-कृत्य ind.p. having cut off or up, having cut out, MBh.; R.
उत्-कृत्यमान mfn. being cut to pieces, being cut up.

उत्-कर्षक mfn. drawing upwards, raising, increasing, Sāh.

extracted
taking a high position
excellent, eminent
superior, best

उत्करीय mfn. relating or belonging to a heap &c., Pāṇ. iv, 2, 90.
उत्कारिकोपनाह m. id., Car.

covered with, Kād.
dug out, perforated, KātyŚr.; Suśr. &c.
pierced
engraved, carved
cut out, Vikr.; Kāvyād.
उत्-कीर्तित mfn. proclaimed, promulgated
praised, celebrated, L.
उत्-कीर्त्य ind.p. having celebrated or praised, Ragh. x, 32
having proclaimed &c.
उत्-√ कॢप् (उद्-√ कॢप्), Caus. P. (impf. 3. pl. -अ॑कल्पयन्, AV. xii, 4, 41) to form, fashion, create.
उत्-केतन n. a raised flag, Dharmaś.
उत्-कोटि mfn. ending in a point or edge, Kād.
उत्-कोठ m. a kind of leprosy, Bhpr.
उत्-कोप mfn. enraged, angry, Alaṃkāras.
उत्-कोरक mfn. having sprouting buds, HPariś.

उत्-क्रम॑ अस्, m. going up or out, VS.; ŚBr. &c.
inverted order, Sūryas.
progressive increase
going astray, acting improperly, deviation, transgression, L.
dying, L.
उत्-क्राम m. going from or out, going above, surpassing, deviating from propriety, transgression
opposition, contrariety, L.
उत्-क्रम॑—ज्या f. (in geom.) the versed sine, Sūryas.
उत्-क्र॑मण n. going up or out, soaring aloft, flight

surpassing, exceeding

उत्-क्रमणीय mfn. to be abandoned or given up, MBh.

passing away, dying, Kathās.

उत्-क्रुष्ट n. the act of crying out, MBh.
calling, exclaiming.

a sea eagle, Suśr.
a watchman, Divyāv.
उत्क्रोशीय mfn. (g. उत्करादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 90), relating or belonging to a clamour &c.

उत्-क्रोदि॑न् mfn. exulting, MaitrS. ii, 5, 7.
उत्-क्लिश्य ind.p. having become uneasy, Suśr.

throwing away

उत्-√ क्ष्विद् (उद्-√ क्ष्विद्) P. -क्ष्वेदति, to creak, MaitrS. iii, 2, 2.
